snippet.title: Rooftops & Alleys || Steam Early Access Announcement
snippet.description:
Wishlist Rooftops & Alleys: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2703850/Rooftops__Alleys_The_Parkour_Game

Time to announce the Steam Early Access launch of 'Rooftops & Alleys' I'm so excited for this next step. It's thanks to all of you and your continous support really! Rooftops & Alleys will launch in early access in Q1/Q2 of 2024. While there is still a few months left before you can get your hands on it, i promise the wait will be worth it! In the meantime, you can go wishlist it on Steam right now!  🙌 🕊️

► Want to support the game? Check out the gofundme below:
https://gofund.me/b8c99479

Affiliate Links:
CASCADEUR (The animation software I use)
Get Cascadeur here: https://link.xsolla.com/DpoiqlJn
Use my promo-code 'PARKOUR' to get 15% off! 🔥
